name: Söll
kurzbeschreibung: Heart of the ski world: Wilder Kaiser–Brixental, with traditional Tiroler hospitality and 90 kilometers of ski runs.
beschreibung:
Söll is located at an altitude of 703 meters in the Unterland around the Kaisergebirge and the Alpbachtal and is an idyllic scattered settlement. The village has around 3,700 inhabitants and extends over a spacious area with typical Tiroler farmhouses and agricultural businesses.

In winter, well-groomed ski slopes and untouched deep-snow runs are a draw, and families appreciate the diverse range of leisure activities and child-friendly accommodations, while hikers get their money's worth on numerous marked trails around the village. In winter (from December to April), the snow-sure location offers ideal conditions. In the summer months (from May to October), the surroundings transform into an outdoor paradise.

Söll is an ideal place for families who want to spend a varied vacation in the mountains. The good transport connections and proximity to larger towns make the stay particularly pleasant.
